summary:
I’m sorry to have to say we’re not coming to Canada as soon as we had wanted, because the doctor says the baby is due too soon now for us to travel. 

 24G 

I think about you a lot, Susie, and tell everyone about you. Any chance of your writing to me? I’d love to hear from you. We—Tessa and I and our cat Pinky—have a nice apartment, and are happy. I lecture at the nearby University and we see many s-f people. Fullerton is straight and placid, very modern, with palm trees and wide streets. The girls are exceptionally pretty (notice I don’t talk as weird as I used to; I’ve calmed down, due to Tessa). I’ve sold two new novels, but I guess Mike Bailey told you. I’m enclosing a Xerox copy of a recent local newspaper item on us, not anywhere nearly as well-written as your husband does. 

Now and then I hear from Jamis, by mail or on the phone. I never hear from Kathy, although she did come down here the first month I was here to see me. We—Tessa and I—were at the LA Worldcon, but again I guess Mike told you. Also, I saw the Broxons at the Westercon. They mention having written you but not having received an answer. Recently Bubbles sent me a color photo of the great steel crab, and many memories swam up into my heart to see him again, so large and beautiful. The guardian of the harbor: I could feel his strength all the way down to us here. Love to you, Susan, and please write me. 

ip K. Dick 

ITO SCOTT MEREDITH]
